We need to determine appropriate crime label(s) based on facts. The facts: Lin (林某甲) was a procurement management officer (专管员) in municipal procurement office. He used his position to accept bribes from bidders (陈某甲, 陈某乙) totaling 184,000 RMB, and helped them win contracts for garbage transfer service and illegal outdoor advertising cleaning. Also later 2014-2015 he used position to give tender information to a bidding agency (林某乙) and received 45,000 RMB. Total 229,000 RMB returned. So crimes: acceptance of bribes (受贿) by a state (public) official. Also possibly abuse of power (滥用职权) because he used his position to influence procurement. The correction lessons: There's a rule about "受贿;滥用职权" for cases where a public official uses position to accept bribes and also abuses authority. Indeed earlier example: "受贿;滥用职权" used for a case where a public official accepted bribes and abused authority. So we should label both.
